text:
maya: Hi folks — I addressed the comments on PR #3821 and pushed a follow-up. PTAL when you have a minute. Changed the batch allocator defaults and added a small smoke script + portability test. Need one approval to unblock the canary tomorrow @11:00 PT.
arjun: Thanks — will take a pass in a bit. quick q: did you keep the dynamic queue fallback behavior intact for short sequences?
maya: yes — fallback preserved. I added a unit test `test_kv_fallback_short_seq` and a note in the code comment. also added `--batch-size=48` default for the runtime for better throughput on our perf buckets.
dave: skimmed the changes. looks good overall. one nit: can we lower the log level for the allocator trace to DEBUG? it's noisy in canary logs.
maya: good call — switched `allocator.trace` -> DEBUG. also added a tiny integration check that asserts kv cache reuse; pasted smoke script snippet below for quick runner:
```
# quick smoke
./tools/smoke_run.sh --model local --batch-size 48 --iterations 10
```
ci-bot: CI triggered for branch maya/pr-3821 — 14 jobs queued. rerunning flaky tests flagged in last run: test_integration_timeout
linda: I can give final approval once CI is green and infra has a quick look at the migration doc (schema change for config). @infra-bot can you peek?
infra-bot: Reviewed migration doc — no schema migration needed for user data. only config surface change; suggested adding a one-line rollout plan. no infra downtime expected. :white_check_mark:
arjun: Left a tiny comment about adding a sentence in the README explaining the new flag semantics. otherwise LGTM.
maya: added the rollout one-liner and README sentence, pushed update, PTAL again. sorry for the ping — trying to catch canary window.
darun (typo in participants removed):
maya: tagging @dave and @arjun for approvals — I'll coordinate canary if we get signoffs. thanks!
arjun: Approved :thumbsup:
dave: Approved after the log-level nit change. :+1:
linda: Approved once CI finishes — will monitor canary. :eyes:
maya: thanks everyone — merging once CI passes and will schedule the canary at 11:00 PT today. I added a short rollback note in the PR description.
